Chapter 4:
Special Announcements

Understand Public Information. Write Clear Announcements. Design Useful Posters.

Jenis Teks: Functional TextFocus: AnnouncementFinal Project: Poster Pengumuman

A. Chapter Overview

Welcome to Chapter 4. In this chapter, you will learn about functional text, especially announcement.

Selamat datang di Chapter 4. Pada bab ini, kalian akan belajar tentang functional text, khususnya announcement atau pengumuman.

Announcement is very useful in school and community life. You can find announcements on school notice boards, classroom walls, student organization posters, class group chats, school social media accounts, community information boards, mosque/church/community hall boards, harbor or boat information boards, digital posters, and public service messages.

Dalam kehidupan siswa, pengumuman sering digunakan untuk memberi informasi tentang kegiatan, perubahan jadwal, lomba, class meeting, pameran karya seni, kerja bakti, webinar, pelatihan, kegiatan komunitas, atau informasi penting lainnya.

For students in island or coastal areas, announcements are also important because they help people receive clear information about school activities, community events, weather-related changes, public meetings, transportation updates, or environmental programs. A good announcement must be clear, short, polite, complete, and easy to understand.

Big Question

How can we write clear, formal, and useful announcements for school and community events?
Bagaimana kita dapat menulis pengumuman yang jelas, formal, dan bermanfaat untuk kegiatan sekolah dan masyarakat?

B. Learning Objectives

After learning this chapter, you are expected to be able to:

  1. identify the social function of announcement text; mengidentifikasi fungsi sosial teks pengumuman;
  2. recognize the structure of an announcement: title, opening, event information, details, contact person, and closing; mengenali struktur pengumuman;
  3. understand printed and digital announcements in school, community, and public contexts; memahami pengumuman cetak dan digital;
  4. find important information in announcements, such as event name, date, time, place, participants, purpose, and requirements; menemukan informasi penting;
  5. use future tense with will and be going to to announce future events; menggunakan future tense;
  6. use passive voice to make formal announcement sentences; menggunakan passive voice;
  7. use polite and formal expressions in announcements; menggunakan ungkapan sopan dan formal;
  8. write a clear announcement for school or community events; menulis pengumuman yang jelas;
  9. design an informative announcement poster for a class meeting or school art exhibition; mendesain poster pengumuman;
  10. evaluate whether an announcement is complete, clear, and appropriate for the audience. mengevaluasi kejelasan pengumuman.

C. Mindful Starter: Notice, Read, Decide

Before learning the text, look at these situations.

Sebelum mempelajari materi, perhatikan situasi berikut. Kalian akan belajar membaca informasi penting, memutuskan apakah pengumuman sudah jelas, dan menulis pengumuman yang berguna untuk orang lain.

Notice BoardClass GroupSchool Social MediaCommunity Poster

Situation 1: Class Meeting Announcement

The student council will hold a class meeting after the semester assessment. The activities include futsal, volleyball, English quiz, poster design, and traditional games. Students need to know the schedule, place, rules, and registration deadline.

Think: What information must be included? Who should read it? Should the language be formal or informal? Where can it be shared?

Situation 2: School Art Exhibition

Grade X students are going to hold an art exhibition at school. They will display paintings, digital posters, handmade crafts, photography, and recycled art. The committee needs to make a clear announcement poster.

Think: What is the event name? When and where will it be held? Who can join or visit? What should visitors do?

Situation 3: Digital Announcement in a Class Group

A teacher sends a message in the class group: “Tomorrow’s English practice will be moved to the language room. Please bring your notebook and dictionary.”

Think: What is the important information? What will happen tomorrow? What should students bring? Why must digital announcements be clear?

Situation 4: Community Announcement

A local youth community will hold a beach-cleaning activity on Saturday morning. The announcement will be shared through a printed poster and a social media post.

Think: What is the purpose? What tools should participants bring? Who can students contact? How can the announcement motivate people politely?

Reflection Questions

  1. What announcement have you read recently? Pengumuman apa yang baru-baru ini kamu baca?
  2. Where did you find it? Di mana kamu menemukannya?
  3. What information did it give? Informasi apa yang disampaikan?
  4. Was the announcement clear? Why? Apakah pengumumannya jelas? Mengapa?
  5. What makes an announcement useful? Apa yang membuat pengumuman bermanfaat?

D–G. Understanding Announcement Text

D. What Is an Announcement?

An announcement is a short functional text that gives important information to people. Announcement adalah teks fungsional singkat yang memberikan informasi penting kepada orang banyak.

An announcement usually tells people about an event, a schedule, a change, a rule, an invitation, a public message, a reminder, or an important instruction.

Social Function

To inform people about something important clearly and effectively.
Fungsi sosial announcement adalah memberi informasi penting kepada orang banyak secara jelas dan efektif.

F. Structure of Announcement Text

1. Title / Heading

The title shows the topic of the announcement. Examples: Class Meeting Announcement, School Art Exhibition, English Club Recruitment, Beach-Cleaning Program, Schedule Change Notice.

2. Opening / Attention Getter

Examples: Attention, all students! To all Grade X students. We are pleased to announce that… Please be informed that…

3. Event Information

Event name, date, time, place, participants, organizer, and purpose.

4. Details / Requirements

Participants must register before Friday. Students are required to wear sports uniforms. Each class should send representatives.

5. Contact Person

For more information, please contact the committee. Please contact your class leader for registration.

6. Closing

Thank you for your attention. We look forward to your participation. Let’s make this event successful.

G. Printed vs Digital Announcement

Printed Announcement

Printed announcements are found on notice boards, posters, banners, or handouts. They need clear titles, large readable text, date/time/place, important details, simple visual design, contact person, official organizer, and polite language.

Digital Announcement

Digital announcements are shared through class groups, school social media, digital posters, or learning platforms. They should be short, complete, polite, easy to read, verified, and not spammy.

AspectPrinted AnnouncementDigital Announcement
Mediapaper, poster, notice boardgroup chat, social media, website
Audiencepeople who see it directlypeople online
Designlarge text, poster layoutshort message, image, caption
Riskmay be missed if not seenmay be forwarded without context
Important pointreadable from distanceclear and verified
Exampleschool board posterclass group message

H–J. Grammar Lab

H. Grammar Lab 1: Future Tense with “Will”

We use will to talk about future events, decisions, promises, predictions, or official announcements. Dalam pengumuman, will sering digunakan untuk menyampaikan apa yang akan terjadi.

Pattern: Subject + will + Verb 1 + Object/Complement

SentenceArti Bahasa Indonesia
The class meeting will be held next week.Class meeting akan diadakan minggu depan.
The school art exhibition will open at 08.00 a.m.Pameran seni sekolah akan dibuka pukul 08.00 pagi.
The committee will share the rules in the class group.Panitia akan membagikan aturan di grup kelas.
The student council will prepare the equipment.OSIS akan menyiapkan perlengkapan.
The winners will receive certificates.Pemenang akan menerima sertifikat.
The event will end at 12.00 p.m.Kegiatan akan berakhir pukul 12.00 siang.
The registration will close on Thursday.Pendaftaran akan ditutup pada Kamis.
Each class will send three representatives.Setiap kelas akan mengirim tiga perwakilan.
The announcement will be posted on the notice board.Pengumuman akan ditempel di papan pengumuman.
The digital poster will be shared on school social media.Poster digital akan dibagikan di media sosial sekolah.

Negative Form

Subject + will not / won’t + Verb 1

SentenceArti Bahasa Indonesia
The event will not be held in the classroom.Kegiatan tidak akan diadakan di kelas.
Registration will not be accepted after the deadline.Pendaftaran tidak akan diterima setelah batas waktu.
Students won’t need to bring sports equipment.Siswa tidak perlu membawa perlengkapan olahraga.
The exhibition will not open before 08.00 a.m.Pameran tidak akan dibuka sebelum pukul 08.00 pagi.

Question Form

Will + Subject + Verb 1?

QuestionAnswerArti
Will the event start at 08.00?Yes, it will.Apakah kegiatan akan dimulai pukul 08.00? Ya.
Will students join the art exhibition?Yes, they will.Apakah siswa akan mengikuti pameran seni? Ya.
Will the meeting be held online?No, it won’t.Apakah rapat akan diadakan secara daring? Tidak.
Will the committee share more information?Yes, it will.Apakah panitia akan membagikan informasi lebih lanjut? Ya.

I. Grammar Lab 2: Future Tense with “Be Going To”

We use be going to to talk about planned future events or intentions. Dalam pengumuman, be going to digunakan ketika rencana sudah disiapkan.

Pattern: Subject + am/is/are + going to + Verb 1

SentenceArti Bahasa Indonesia
The student council is going to organize a class meeting.OSIS akan mengadakan class meeting.
Grade X students are going to display their artworks.Siswa kelas X akan memajang karya seni mereka.
The committee is going to prepare the stage.Panitia akan menyiapkan panggung.
We are going to design an announcement poster.Kami akan mendesain poster pengumuman.
The art club is going to invite visitors.Klub seni akan mengundang pengunjung.
The school is going to hold a community service program.Sekolah akan mengadakan program bakti sosial.
Students are going to perform music and poetry.Siswa akan menampilkan musik dan puisi.
The class leaders are going to collect registration forms.Ketua kelas akan mengumpulkan formulir pendaftaran.
SubjectBe Going To FormExample
Iam going toI am going to join the poster design competition.
He/She/Itis going toShe is going to perform a song.
We/You/Theyare going toThey are going to prepare the stage.
The committeeis going toThe committee is going to announce the rules.
Studentsare going toStudents are going to visit the exhibition.

Will vs Be Going To

WillBe Going To
often used for formal announcements, decisions, promises, future factsoften used for planned actions or intentions
The event will start at 08.00.The committee is going to prepare the stage.
The winners will be announced at noon.We are going to make a digital poster.
Further information will be shared later.The students are going to display their artworks.

J. Grammar Lab 3: Passive Voice for Formal Announcements

Passive voice focuses on the action or result, not the person who does the action. Dalam pengumuman formal, passive voice sering digunakan karena terdengar lebih resmi dan sopan.

Pattern: Future Passive
Subject + will be + Verb 3

Active SentencePassive SentenceArti Passive Sentence
The committee will hold the event.The event will be held by the committee.Kegiatan akan diadakan oleh panitia.
The principal will open the exhibition.The exhibition will be opened by the principal.Pameran akan dibuka oleh kepala sekolah.
The committee will announce the winners.The winners will be announced by the committee.Pemenang akan diumumkan oleh panitia.
The teacher will share the schedule.The schedule will be shared by the teacher.Jadwal akan dibagikan oleh guru.
Students will submit the artworks.The artworks will be submitted by students.Karya seni akan dikumpulkan oleh siswa.

Common Passive Voice in Announcements

Passive SentenceArti Bahasa Indonesia
The event will be held in the school hall.Kegiatan akan diadakan di aula sekolah.
The exhibition will be opened by the principal.Pameran akan dibuka oleh kepala sekolah.
The winners will be announced by the committee.Pemenang akan diumumkan oleh panitia.
The artworks will be displayed in the library.Karya seni akan dipajang di perpustakaan.
The schedule will be shared in the class group.Jadwal akan dibagikan di grup kelas.
The announcement will be posted on the notice board.Pengumuman akan ditempel di papan pengumuman.
The registration form will be collected by the class leader.Formulir pendaftaran akan dikumpulkan oleh ketua kelas.
Visitors will be guided by the committee.Pengunjung akan dipandu oleh panitia.
The event will be supervised by teachers.Kegiatan akan diawasi oleh guru.
The rules will be explained before the competition starts.Aturan akan dijelaskan sebelum lomba dimulai.

Why Use Passive Voice?

  • it sounds more formal;
  • it focuses on the event or information;
  • it is common in official announcements;
  • it avoids unnecessary personal focus;
  • it makes the announcement sound polite and professional.

Common Mistakes

IncorrectCorrectExplanation
The event will held tomorrow.The event will be held tomorrow.Future passive needs “will be + Verb 3.”
The winners will announced at noon.The winners will be announced at noon.Add “be.”
The schedule will be share later.The schedule will be shared later.Use Verb 3: shared.
The exhibition will be open by principal.The exhibition will be opened by the principal.Use Verb 3 and article.
Artworks will display in library.Artworks will be displayed in the library.Use “will be + displayed.”

M–P. Model Texts

M. Model Text 1: Class Meeting Announcement

Announcement

Attention, all students!

The student council is pleased to announce that the Class Meeting 2026 will be held after the semester assessment. This event will be organized to strengthen teamwork, sportsmanship, creativity, and friendship among students.

InformationDetails
Day/DateMonday–Wednesday, 15–17 June 2026
Time08.00 a.m. – 12.00 p.m.
PlaceSchool yard and classrooms
ParticipantsAll students of Grade X, XI, and XII
OrganizerStudent Council

The competitions will include futsal, volleyball, English quiz, poster design, traditional games, and class performance. Each class must send representatives for each competition.

Registration will be opened on Monday, 8 June 2026 and will be closed on Friday, 12 June 2026. Class leaders are requested to submit the registration forms to the student council committee.

All participants are required to wear appropriate uniforms and follow the competition rules. The rules will be shared in the class group and posted on the notice board.

For more information, please contact the student council committee.

Thank you for your attention.
Let’s make the class meeting fun, fair, and successful.

Student Council Committee

We are pleased to announce that the School Art Exhibition: Colors of Our Island will be held next month. This exhibition is going to display students’ creativity through paintings, digital posters, photography, recycled crafts, and handmade artworks.

InformationDetails
Day/DateFriday, 26 June 2026
Time08.30 a.m. – 01.00 p.m.
PlaceSchool hall and library corner
ParticipantsGrade X students

Activity 1: Pair Talk — What Is the Announcement About?

Bekerjalah berpasangan. Bacalah sebuah pengumuman singkat dari guru atau temanmu. Tanyakan pertanyaan berikut.

Activity 2: Mini Dialogue

Alya: Rian, did you read the announcement about the school art exhibition?
Rian: Yes, I did. It will be held next Friday in the school hall.
Alya: Who can join the exhibition?
Rian: Grade X students can submit their artworks.
Alya: What kind of artworks will be displayed?
Rian: Paintings, digital posters, photography, and recycled crafts.
Alya: When is the deadline for submission?
Rian: The artworks must be submitted before Monday.
Alya: Who should we contact for more information?
Rian: We should contact the Art Club committee or our class leader.
Alya: Great. I am going to submit my digital poster.
Rian: Good idea. I’m going to prepare my artwork too.

Arti Singkat: Alya dan Rian membicarakan pengumuman pameran seni sekolah. Mereka menemukan informasi penting, seperti waktu, tempat, peserta, jenis karya, batas pengumpulan, dan narahubung. Mereka juga menggunakan future tense: will be held, am going to submit, dan am going to prepare.

T–Z. Writing, Digital Announcement, Poster Design, and Common Mistakes

T. Writing Section: Writing an Announcement

Pada bagian ini, kalian akan menulis announcement text tentang kegiatan sekolah atau komunitas.

Class MeetingSchool Art ExhibitionEnglish Club RecruitmentDigital Poster CompetitionBeach-Cleaning ProgramSchool WebinarReading CampaignStudent Creativity DayCommunity Service ProgramSchedule Change Notice

Step-by-Step Writing Guide

  1. Choose the topic: What event will you announce?
  2. Identify the audience: all students, Grade X students, class leaders, art club members, school community, or youth community members.
  3. Write event information: event name, organizer, date, time, place, participants, and purpose.
  4. Add details and requirements: register before Friday, wear sports uniforms, bring notebooks, submit artworks, bring reusable bottles, follow the rules, come on time.
  5. Add future tense and passive voice: use at least 3 sentences with will, 2 sentences with be going to, and 2 passive voice sentences.
  6. Add contact person and closing: For more information, please contact the committee. Thank you for your attention.
  7. Revise: check title, audience, date, time, place, requirements, polite language, future tense, passive voice, and readability.

V. Student Draft and Revised Version

Student Draft

Announcement class meeting. Student council will make class meeting next week. It is in school yard. There is futsal and volleyball. Students must register. The winner will announce. Contact OSIS. Thank you.

Revised Version

Class Meeting Announcement

Attention, all students! The student council is pleased to announce that the Class Meeting 2026 will be held next week. The event is going to include futsal, volleyball, English quiz, poster design, and traditional games.

The class meeting will be held on Monday, 15 June 2026, from 08.00 a.m. to 12.00 p.m. in the school yard. Each class must send representatives for every competition. Registration will be closed on Friday, 12 June 2026. All participants are required to follow the rules and wear appropriate uniforms.

The winners will be announced at the end of the event. For more information, please contact the student council committee. Thank you for your attention. Let’s make this class meeting fun and successful.

Problems in the Draft

ProblemExplanation
“Announcement class meeting”Judul belum natural. Gunakan “Class Meeting Announcement.”
“will make class meeting”Lebih tepat: “will hold a class meeting.”
“It is in school yard”Untuk kegiatan masa depan gunakan “will be held in the school yard.”
“There is futsal and volleyball”Untuk masa depan gunakan “There will be…”
“Students must register”Perlu deadline agar jelas.
“The winner will announce”Passive voice harus: “The winners will be announced.”
“Contact OSIS”Lebih sopan: “For more information, please contact the student council committee.”
Detail kurang lengkapPerlu tanggal, waktu, tempat, peserta, dan aturan.

The revised version is better because the title is clear, the audience is clear, the date/time/place are complete, the event details are specific, the language is more formal, future tense and passive voice are used correctly, the contact information is polite, and the closing is positive.

W. Digital Announcement Corner

A good digital announcement should be clear, short, complete, polite, verified, easy to read, not too long, not spammy, and shared by an official or trusted sender.

Weak Digital Announcement

Tomorrow event moved. Bring things. Don’t forget. Ask in group.

Problems: unclear event, no date, no place, no time, unclear “things,” no sender, not formal enough.

Better Digital Announcement

Good afternoon, Grade X students.
Please be informed that tomorrow’s English speaking practice will be moved to the language room.

Day/Date: Tuesday, 9 June 2026
Time: 09.00 a.m.
Place: Language room
Requirement: Bring your notebook, dictionary, and previous worksheet.

Further information will be shared in this group. Thank you.
English Teacher

Digital Announcement Checklist

ChecklistYes/No
The title or topic is clear.
The audience is clear.
The date is included.
The time is included.
The place is included.
The requirements are clear.
The sender is clear.
The language is polite.
The message is not too long.
The information is official or verified.

X. Poster Design Corner

An announcement poster is a visual announcement that combines text, design, and images to inform people about an event. Poster harus mudah dibaca, tidak terlalu ramai, dan tetap lengkap informasinya.

Important Elements of an Announcement Poster

  • Big title: catches attention
  • Event name: tells what the event is
  • Date and time: tells when it happens
  • Place: tells where it happens
  • Organizer: tells who organizes it
  • Requirements: tells what participants need
  • Contact person: gives more information
  • Visual design: makes it attractive and readable
  • Short message: motivates people to join

Poster Design Tips

TipArti Bahasa Indonesia
Use a clear title.Gunakan judul yang jelas.
Make the date and time easy to see.Buat tanggal dan waktu mudah terlihat.
Use readable fonts.Gunakan jenis huruf yang mudah dibaca.
Do not use too many colors.Jangan gunakan terlalu banyak warna.
Keep enough spacing.Beri jarak yang cukup.
Use relevant images or icons.Gunakan gambar atau ikon yang relevan.
Check spelling carefully.Periksa ejaan dengan teliti.
Make sure the information is complete.Pastikan informasinya lengkap.
Use polite and formal language.Gunakan bahasa yang sopan dan formal.
Avoid crowding the poster with too much text.Hindari membuat poster terlalu penuh teks.

Z. Common Mistakes in Announcement Text

Weak / IncorrectBetter / CorrectExplanation
Class meeting tomorrow. Join it.The class meeting will be held on Monday, 15 June 2026, at 08.00 a.m. in the school yard.Missing important information.
The event will held tomorrow.The event will be held tomorrow.Passive voice needs “will be + Verb 3.”
The committee going to announce the rules.The committee is going to announce the rules.Use “is going to.”
Students will to join the event.Students will join the event.After will, use Verb 1.
Hey guys, come to the event!Attention, all students. Please join the event.Use formal language.
Tomorrow moved to room. Bring book.Tomorrow’s English practice will be moved to the language room. Please bring your notebook and dictionary.Digital announcement must be clear.
Poster Too Crowded: A poster becomes difficult to read if the title is too small, the colors are too many, the text is too long, the date and place are hidden, the font is difficult to read, the image does not match the event, or there is no contact person.

End of Chapter Message

Announcements help people receive important information.
A good announcement is clear, complete, polite, and easy to read.
When you write an announcement, you help others understand what will happen, where it will happen, and what they should do.

Be clear. Be polite. Be informative.
